title: done_output returns 'unexpected answer' without Asked::give_back, so a reserved screenshot slot is never released
trigger: An input tool with screenshot:true gets a UiReply that is not Done from the UI thread
effect: One of the 20 screenshots per minute is spent though none was taken, until the limiter window rolls over
fix: a slot guard that releases on Drop so every early return gives it back

title: A handed-over composer send is cleared by (account, chat id, text) match, not by an id of the send
trigger: Agent presses Send in the window; during the confirm wait (up to 120 s) the user edits the box or retypes the same text, or the send ran from a chat window
effect: The delivered text can stay in the box (user sends it twice) or a retyped identical text is cleared; the answer is matched by chat and text rather than a send id
fix: carry a SendId in UiSend and ComposerSent and match that

title: Asked holds options, skipped and slot as three Options kept in step by hand
trigger: An input tool is called with screenshot:true
effect: No bug today: slot is Some iff options is Some, and skipped is Some only when neither is; every reader assumes the pairing
fix: enum ShotAsk { NotAsked, Reserved{options, slot}, Skipped(note) } whose Drop releases the slot

title: set_draft overwrites or clears the user's own unsent draft without confirmation or a look at what is there
trigger: User has typed a draft in a chat; an agent with read_write calls set_draft (text or empty)
effect: The user's draft text is replaced or erased; set_draft is the one write tool with confirms_sends false that destroys user text
fix: read the current draft first and refuse or confirm when it is non-empty and differs

title: send_file and td_call check that each path is outside Quill's data folder once, before the confirm prompt and paced queue wait, and not again when the file goes out
trigger: Agent passes a path it controls; while the call waits (confirm up to 120 s, paced queue) it swaps the file for a link into the data folder
effect: A sign-in key or token file could be uploaded: the check ran on the old target (td_call check_uploads has the same gap)
fix: re-run the check at the queue turn inside common::send, or open the file once and send the handle

title: Guard keeps the injecting stage as Mode{Idle,Injecting} beside an open-command counter and a never-cleared step slot
trigger: An agent input command runs: src/ui/agent_driver.rs begin()s an OpenCommand (open += 1), then perform_step calls set_injecting(true) and later set_injecting(false) by hand around each step; with_injecting nests and restores `was`.
effect: No bug today. The stage of one agent command is spread over three values kept in step by call sites: Guard::mode (two-variant flag in disguise, hard-reset to Idle by perform_step rather than restored), Guard::open (u32 count of unanswered commands) and Guard::step (Option set at begin, never cleared, so a deferred refusal after the agent left is logged under the stale agent/tool). A path that sets true and returns before set_injecting(false) would leave every user write refused.
fix: One stage value owned by the command (e.g. an Injecting guard type that restores the previous mode on Drop, carrying agent and tool), replacing set_injecting(bool) and the step slot

title: observe() resets a Session by hand (run, started_ms, last_ms, action, agent) on a read, outside the session's own transitions
trigger: Pause the driver (Esc), let the agent disconnect (session.run becomes Ended), then reconnect an agent: any with_facts caller (snapshot/current/note_*) runs observe, which rewrites the ended Session in place back to Running with the agent name cleared.
effect: No bug today (the pill comes back unnamed so the user can Let it continue). The stage lives in Facts::session.run (Running/Ended), Facts::hold (None/Paused/Stopped) and Session fields that must change together; observe re-opens an ended session field by field and every read of current() can mutate the record, so a new reader that locks FACTS without with_facts sees a different stage.
fix: Make the revival a named transition (e.g. Session::revive_for_pause, or a Facts stage enum {NoSession, Running, Ended, PausedUnnamed}) called from the connect event, not from every read

title: CreateJoinAs is a request stage held as request + answer: Option<Result<..,()>>, beside CreateStep::Waiting(request) in the box
trigger: Start video chat: request_create_join_as stores Some(CreateJoinAs{answer:None}) in session.calls.create_join_as while the UI holds the same RequestId in GroupCallCreate::step Waiting; settings/apply.rs and calls/error.rs write the answer, group_call_create_frame_upkeep reads it per frame and clears it by hand (answer.is_some() || orphaned)
effect: no stuck state found; the stage is split across two owners (session slot and box) and reset from the render-time upkeep, and an account that is off screen keeps its slot until it is on screen again
fix: Fetch<Vec<MessageSender>> (or Asking{request}/Ready/Failed) keyed by the request, owned by the box, with the answer routed to the box by request id

title: MutedSpeechHint::peak lives beside HintStage and is reset by hand in two places
trigger: Mute in a group call, talk, unmute and re-mute
effect: peak is only meaningful in Listening but is a separate field zeroed on Idle->Listening and after each check; a stale peak from an earlier stretch is read nowhere today
fix: Move peak into HintStage::Listening { tester, due, peak }

title: max - min + 1 on u8 keycodes from the X server is unchecked
trigger: X server reports min_keycode 0 and max_keycode 255
effect: u8 overflow panics in debug and wraps to 0 in release (empty mapping, Unsupported); panic-safety rule 5
fix: max.saturating_sub(min).saturating_add(1) or u16 arithmetic

title: revoking() overwrites an in-flight Revoke::Asking and is a no-op outside Ready, while the request is already sent
trigger: Open Stream with..., Revoke the key twice before the first answer (no guard on Asking in revoke_rtmp_start_key)
effect: The first request's answer or failure no longer matches (accept/fail return false), so its failure falls to the generic error path and its key is dropped; a revoke sent while not Ready is untracked
fix: Refuse a second revoke while Asking (driver checks the stage before sending) and make revoking() return whether it was recorded

title: DeviceRun { Opening, Running } is kept in step by hand with DeviceThread's one-shot answer channel; opened() is only valid while Opening
trigger: A caller polls DeviceThread::opened() a second time after it already returned Some(Ok(())) (callers in connect/call_capture.rs, call_screen.rs guard it only by checking their own DeviceRun::is_opening()).
effect: No bug today: the answer sender is dropped after the one answer, so a second poll reports Err('The capture thread stopped.') for a healthy device; correctness depends on every owner flipping DeviceRun::Opening to Running in the same step as consuming the answer.
fix: Make DeviceThread hold its own stage (Opening { answer } / Running / Failed) so opened() is idempotent and the owner's DeviceRun<T> carries only T, or fold the device and its feeder into one enum value.

title: PipeWire Unconnected before the first Streaming state is dropped, so the share never ends
trigger: Start a Wayland screen share; the PipeWire stream goes Connecting -> Paused -> Unconnected (compositor or node goes away during negotiation) without ever reaching Streaming.
effect: StreamPhase is still Connecting, so state_changed pushes no Ended event; the capture counts as running with zero frames until the portal session itself closes. The call shows a share that sends nothing.
fix: Separate the initial Unconnected from a later one (for example StreamPhase::Negotiating after Connecting is seen, ending on Unconnected from there), or push Ended on any Unconnected that follows a Connecting/Paused change.

title: Stopping a macOS window share joins a monitor thread that can be inside a 5 s ScreenCaptureKit wait
trigger: Share a window on macOS, then stop the share (or end the call) while the 500 ms monitor is in window_state() -> shareable_content(false), which waits up to REPLY_TIMEOUT (5 s) for the completion handler.
effect: WindowMonitor::drop sends stop then worker.join(), so MacCapture::stop (called from the connect driver pump) blocks for up to 5 s when ScreenCaptureKit answers slowly; the app freezes for that time.
fix: Do not join in drop: let the thread own its Arc<StreamShared>, check shared.stopped after the content call and exit by itself, or give the monitor a stop flag the wait can observe.

title: A Failed feeder still sends segment and stream requests until the rejoin replaces it
trigger: A stream part answers GROUPCALL_JOIN_MISSING/FORBIDDEN while the rejoin cannot start (chats path inactive/locked, no engine, or rejoin not Idle so want() is a no-op); connect/group_calls/stream.rs only calls want() + maybe_auto_rejoin_group_call and drains the feeder only inside rejoin_tracked_group_call after its early returns
effect: tgcalls re-asks NotReady parts every ~100 ms and each one sends getGroupCallStreamSegment that fails again with RejoinNeeded, until the call is left; on_part_request and on_time_request never check state Failed/Ended
fix: Refuse requests (answer ResyncNeeded without sending) when state is Failed or Ended, or drain the feeder as soon as Rejoin is returned

title: StreamsSync { Idle, Asking } sits beside FeederState::Syncing, which on_time_request sets before the send
trigger: on_time_request on an Idle rtmp feeder sets state=Syncing, then request_streams fails; the None arm answers 0 but state stays Syncing with StreamsSync::Idle. A reply with channels also sets Syncing with no request out
effect: no visible effect today (Syncing and Idle both map to StreamState::Connecting) but two values name the same 'waiting for the stream list' stage and are kept in step by hand
fix: One enum for the feeder whose Syncing variant carries the Asking request and waiters

title: StreamQualityTracker marks a bucket as reported before the engine has taken it
trigger: report_stream_tile_width (connect/group_calls/stream.rs:276) calls observe(), then engine.set_stream_quality; with no engine or no GroupCall for the chat yet (TgcallsEngine::set_group_stream_quality returns silently), the tracker already holds the bucket
effect: the same tile width is never reported again, so an RTMP stream's unified video keeps the Thumbnail minimum quality while its tile is Full
fix: Record the bucket only after the engine confirms it (set_stream_quality returns bool), or clear the tracker when the engine call appears

title: Group call output mute is stored twice: GroupCall::playback_muted and SoundSlot Wanted::muted
trigger: set_group_output writes call.playback_muted and call.context.sound.set_muted(muted); open_group_sound passes playback_muted back into Wanted::muted on each reopen
effect: no divergence today; two copies must change together by hand (volume has the same shape: Engine::stream_volume and Wanted::volume)
fix: Keep the choice only in SoundSlot::wanted and read it when reopening

title: SampleRing::pop loads write before read, so a producer that pushes and drops in between makes read pass the stale write
trigger: Consumer thread preempted between the two loads while the engine thread pushes two or more 10 ms frames into a full ring
effect: write.wrapping_sub(read) wraps to a huge count, pop copies garbage and CASes read past write; len() stays huge and push_with's used + count can overflow (debug panic, release wrap), leaving stream audio stuck on stale samples until the output is reopened
fix: Load read first, then write (write >= read always), or clamp count to capacity

title: ChatUi::pending_delete is a one-shot hand-off slot: set and taken in the same call
trigger: Delete from selection mode (selection_mode.rs:935 sets it then calls confirm_delete)
effect: No frame ever reads pending_delete (the box is the kit alert; only demos set it without taking), so it is not state; confirm_delete's take() drops the confirm silently when there is neither a live client nor a demo session. The slot invites a future writer that leaves it set across an owner change
fix: Pass the DeleteConfirm as an argument to confirm_delete(confirm, cx) and delete the field

title: ReplacementProbe::Probing names a background probe but holds no job or Task; the answer is matched by path only
trigger: Stage a replacement video, clear it and stage the same path again, or re-cut it to the same output path while the first probe runs
effect: probe_edit_replacement spawns a detached scoped task per call; finish_edit_replacement_probe accepts any answer whose path equals the staged one while Probing, so two probes of one path race and the older answer can settle a newer Probing (harmless while the file is unchanged, wrong if the file changed under the same path)
fix: Probing { job } (or { task }) held in the stage and compared on finish, as Reads::Reading{job} does

title: 'Send without compression' on then off turns a soundless video or edited GIF into a plain video
trigger: Add a soundless mp4 (GifMode::Gif) or a video edited to a GIF, tick Send without compression, untick it, send
effect: set_send_as_files(true) calls set_gif(false) (attachments.rs:107); the way back for media restores only kind (attachments.rs:109-114), never set_gif(true), and extras.edits.gif stays true. The file goes out as a video, not an animation (the editor copy has lost its sound)
fix: Keep the GIF choice as GifMode only in one place and derive it from edits; restore it with the kind

title: AttachmentExtras: gif, source, edits, start_timestamp and path are one video-edit decision stored in five fields
trigger: Save the video editor (ui/video_editor.rs:535-548)
effect: gif is computed from edits.gif && has_audio, start_timestamp from edits, source is Some only if edited, path is the copy; set_gif and the tray code change gif alone, so they can disagree with edits
fix: VideoPrep::{Untouched, Edited{source, edits}} with gif and start_timestamp derived

title: ComposerSnapshot holds attachment and album as two fields; 'empty when attachment is the single send' is by hand
trigger: Capture a send with a single attachment or an album
effect: attachment: Option and album: Vec are exclusive by convention (is_album, needs_media_prep, prepare read both; PreparedMedia::prepare derives 'alone' from album.is_empty())
fix: SendContent::{Text, Single(ComposerAttachment), Album(Vec<..>)}

title: One installed-backgrounds Fetch serves both the light and dark theme list
trigger: Open Appearance in the light theme (list fetched with for_dark_theme=false), switch the app theme to dark, open Appearance or the chat look box again
effect: fetch_installed_backgrounds(for_dark_theme) returns Ok(None) unless the Fetch is Idle, and the Fetch is not keyed by theme, so the dark gallery shows the light list (and the reverse) for the rest of the session
fix: Fetch keyed by theme (HashMap<bool, Fetch<..>>) or refetch when the theme differs

title: installed_backgrounds begin() is called twice and the request is never recorded; the answer is matched by purpose
trigger: Open the wallpaper page
effect: Fetch::begin leaves Loading{request: None}; Fetch::sent(extra) is never called, so the answer and the error act for GetInstalledBackgrounds by purpose (chats/error.rs:34, chats/apply.rs:453) and dedupe scans requests.pending for the purpose (backgrounds.rs:25). The second begin() at line 50 does nothing
fix: Call installed_backgrounds.sent(extra) once and match answers on the held RequestId; drop the second begin()

title: Login-URL button: login_url_request and last_login_url_info are two Options that form one stage, filled before the send
trigger: Press a login-URL button when the send fails (send_login_url_info / send_login_url)
effect: The context is written before send_json_request and not cleared when it returns Err, so a stale LoginUrlRequest stays until the next press; it is also taken by hand in the error arm (bots/error.rs:210), poll_drains.rs:260 and session_outcomes.rs:26. The answer is matched by purpose, not by the RequestId
fix: LoginUrlStage::{Idle, Asking{request, context}, Answered{info, context}}

title: Inline query slot is Loading without the request; answers are matched by (chat, bot, first_page)
trigger: Type '@bot query', then change the query while a page is in flight
effect: InlineQuerySlot::fetch Loading holds no RequestId; apply_inline_query_results and the error arm compare chat_id, bot_user_id and the stage, and has_inline_query_in_flight dedupes by (chat, bot). A first-page send failure also writes None over a Loaded slot of the previous query (bots.rs:663)
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading{request: RequestId, query}; apply only when the id matches
